summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting the entry into Equity Distribution Agreements by Gladstone Land Corporation and its operating partnership with Virtu Americas LLC and Lucid Capital Markets LLC. These agreements allow the company to sell up to $500 million of its common stock from time to time in at-the-market offerings. The Sales Agents are entitled to compensation up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. The shares will be issued under an existing shelf registration statement. No event triggers a special-situation classification.
